sovereign_country.strategic_role: 海湾阿拉伯国家自贸走廊、外资100%控股与印度洋海运枢纽

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Publishing of Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Games

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Oman (national regulatory scope; no sub-state tax distinction; municipal licensing of the registered office applies in the Muscat Governorate)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (codified statutes; Islamic Sharia is a principal source of legislation under Article 2 of the Basic Law; commercial, labor, and administrative courts operate separately; legal persons governed by the Commercial Companies Law, Royal Decree 18/2019)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: US-Oman Free Trade Agreement (entry into force 1 January 2009, Chapter 10 investment protections)
Oman-United Kingdom BIT (1992, continued in force post-Brexit)
GCC Unified Economic Agreement (intra-GCC establishment and capital movement)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Companies Law of the Sultanate of Oman, Royal Decree No. 18/2019, as amended, particularly Articles 1 (definitions), 56–63 (Single Person Company), 24–25 (incorporation), and Chapter III (limited liability companies); supplemental Executive Regulations issued by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP) – Directorate General of Commercial Registration and Licensing, acting through the electronic Invest Easy national portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Single Person Company, filed as one consolidated electronic incorporation application with issuance of the Commercial Registration Certificate by MOCIIP.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Oman law imposes no statutory minimum paid-up capital for a Single Person Company. The Sole Shareholder determines the capital in the Memorandum of Association, which must be fully subscribed, denominated in Omani Rials, deposited into a licensed Omani bank account, and evidenced by a bank capital-certificate before registration. No escrow account or phased payment is mandated.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: that the Company be incorporated as a Single Person Company under the Commercial Companies Law of the Sultanate of Oman; that the Memorandum and Articles of Association be approved and submitted to the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion; that the registered office at P.O. Box ___ , Muscat, Sultanate of Oman be adopted; that the subscribed share capital credited to the Company's bank account be ratified; that [Name] be appointed Managing Director, [Name] be appointed Chief Financial Officer, and [Name] be appointed Company Secretary, each with authority to execute statutory filings, open bank accounts, and represent the Company; and that all prior incorporation actions are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Trade Name Reservation and Pre-Registration Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log on to the Invest Easy portal, create a user profile, select 'Single Person Company', and submit a trade name reservation request for the proposed Arabic and English company name. The name must comply with Omani naming restrictions and must not conflict with existing registered names. The activity code ISIC 5820 is entered to define software publishing. The system will issue an electronic name reservation certificate once approved. Notarization is not required at this stage.
required_dossiers: Digital passport copy of the sole corporate shareholder or natural person
Proposed Arabic trade name and English transliteration
Copy of the shareholder's residency document, if natural person resident in Oman
Power of attorney if a corporate agent is used
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused due to similarity or public-order grounds, the applicant may submit up to three alternative names through the same portal. A formal objection may be lodged with the MOCIIP Name Committee within 15 days of refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, Approval and Notarization of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Omani Notary Public / MOCIIP Legal Documentation Department and Ministry of Justice notarial offices
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the consolidated Arabic-language Memorandum and Articles of Association stating the company name, legal form, registered office address, share capital, shareholder details, managers, and the ISIC 5820 software publishing purpose. The document must be signed by the sole shareholder and witnessed. Thereafter, it must be notarized before a licensed Omani notary public in original form; digital notarization through the Ministry of Justice electronic system is accepted for locally resident signatories.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Trade name reservation certificate
Passport copy of shareholder and each proposed manager
Original certificate of incumbency for corporate shareholder, if applicable
Proof of address or right to use the proposed registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or MOCIIP reviewer identifies substantive defects, the applicant must file an amended instrument. A query notice setting out missing clauses is issued; the corrected document must be re-submitted within 30 days to avoid lapse of the name reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Capital Deposit and Capital Confirmation Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial bank in Oman (Corporate Banking Department)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate bank account or temporary capital-subscription account at an Omani bank in the company's name. Transfer the subscribed paid-up capital via inward remittance from the sole shareholder or place it directly in the account. Obtain a bank certificate confirming receipt, the amount credited, and the account beneficiary. This certificate is required by MOCIIP for final registration.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Passport copies of authorized signatories
Shareholder's source-of-funds declaration
Bank account opening forms and FATCA-CRS declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries source of funds or ultimate beneficial ownership, provide a certified business plan, shareholder passport, and clear transaction history. If the query is unresolved within 10 business days, choose another licensed bank and restart the deposit process with enhanced supporting documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing and Issuance of Commercial Registration Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOCIIP – Directorate General of Commercial Registration and Licensing via Invest Easy
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association, bank capital certificate, trade name certificate, proof of registered office, and shareholder/officer identification into the Invest Easy incorporation application. Pay the statutory registration fee and municipal preliminary fee electronically. After final checks by the commercial registry officer, the online system issues the Commercial Registration Certificate ('CR') with the tax identification number assigned by the Secretariat General for Taxation.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association in Arabic
Bank capital confirmation certificate
Trade name reservation certificate
Registered office lease or title deed and landlord consent
Passport copy of shareholder and managers
Possibly audited financial statement of corporate shareholder, if foreign corporate entity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, MOCIIP issues a notice listing missing documents or corrections. The applicant has a 30-day cure period to respond electronically; failure to cure results in rejection with refund of certain fees. The applicant may resubmit after rectification or appeal to the Commercial Registration Complaint Committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Municipal, Tax, Chamber and Civil Defense Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Muscat Municipality; Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI); Secretariat General for Taxation; Royal Oman Police – Civil Defense and Ambulance Directorate
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the Commercial Registration Certificate, apply to the Muscat Municipality or relevant governorate municipality for the municipal operating license for software publishing activity. Enroll the company with the Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry as an active member. Register for income and withholding tax with the Secretariat General for Taxation through the Tax Authority e-service. If any employees are hired, register with the Public Authority for Social Insurance. Arrange a fire safety inspection of the registered office with the Civil Defense and Ambulance Directorate and obtain the occupancy clearance certificate.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration Certificate
Lease contract of the licensed premises
Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Manager and shareholder ID copies
Premises layout and electrical safety report
Completed municipal/tax/chamber application forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a municipal or civil defense clearance is withheld, the applicant must rectify building-code deficiencies, pay the prescribed administrative fee, and re-inspect. Tax registration issues are cured by submitting the correct supporting documents through the Tax Authority e-portal. OCCI refusal may be appealed to the OCCI membership committee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion – Commercial Licensing Directorate and the relevant Governorate Municipality
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipal Operating License for 'Computer Game Software Publishing (Expression of Game Software and Interactive Entertainment Content)' read with the Commercial Registration Certificate under ISIC 5820; equivalent to NAICS 511210 'Software Publishers'.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority of the Sultanate of Oman (EA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – Non-Industrial Digital Service / Office-Based Activity; no full EIA or environmental registration required for pure MMORPG software publishing without physical manufacturing or data-center operations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to software code production; however, the office must comply with Muscat Municipality solid waste segregation and municipal wastewater disposal standards. Any electronic waste from disposed computer hardware must be transferred to EA-approved recyclers in accordance with the Waste Management Regulation. Zero volatile organic compounds and zero industrial process discharges are expected for the activity.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The registered office and any work site must obtain a Fire Safety Compliance Certificate issued by the Royal Oman Police – Civil Defense and Ambulance Directorate, including compliance with NFPA/Oman Fire Code requirements. A structural safety inspection for the leased premises must be completed by the municipality or an authorized engineering office. Occupancy and workplace health clearances must be issued by the Ministry of Labour and the licensed civil engineer, covering ergonomic workstation arrangements, emergency exits, and fire extinguishers.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA) — electronic portal: Tax Portal at https://taxoman.gov.om
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities forming a Single Person Company (SPC) in Oman must register for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) through the Oman Tax Authority portal. The SPC must submit its articles of association, Commercial Registration (CR) certificate issued by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion, and proof of registered address. The application is filed online through the Tax Portal; upon approval, the OTA issues a TIN and VAT registration certificate where applicable. For VAT, the SPC must register if taxable supplies exceed the mandatory threshold; voluntary registration is available if the threshold is met. Foreign-owned SPCs with no local establishment but making taxable supplies may require registration through a tax representative.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the SPC is a separate legal person subject to corporate income tax at rates depending on income bracket; no general pass-through regime. Territorial scope: Oman taxes resident companies on Oman-sourced income and foreign income attributable to a permanent establishment in Oman. Non-resident shareholders distributing dividends from an SPC may be subject to withholding tax. Tax-Exempt Zone status may apply under the Special Economic Zone at Duqm (SEZAD) or Free Zones subject to separate tax incentives but not default for an SPC registered in the mainland.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Oman does not provide a check-the-box pass-through election for SPCs. An SPC may elect to be taxed as a partnership? No, SPC is a corporate entity. No hybrid mismatch elections are available under Omani tax law. The SPC may, however, elect to adopt IFRS for tax accounting, and may apply for advance pricing agreements or tax treaty relief on double taxation where relevant. No statutory entity classification election exists; the SPC is mandatorily taxed as a corporation.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) implemented under the unified GCC VAT framework
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: OMR 38,500 (mandatory annual taxable supplies) / OMR 19,250 (voluntary threshold)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Oman does not yet mandate real-time e-invoicing clearance or digital fiscal stamping for B2B transactions as of the knowledge cutoff, but the Oman Tax Authority has announced phased implementation of electronic invoicing. Tax invoices must be issued for taxable supplies, and VAT returns are filed electronically via the OTA Tax Portal. For digital services and imported telecom/electronic services, the supplier may need to register under the simplified non-resident VAT regime; no real-time API clearance is currently operative.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods to countries outside the GCC are zero-rated for VAT upon satisfying customs export requirements. Exports of services related to real property or goods outside Oman may be zero-rated if supplied to a non-resident who is outside Oman at the time of supply, and the recipient does not receive the service in Oman. For digital gaming services, offshore services provided to non-resident customers (overseas app store users) can be zero-rated if the place of supply is outside Oman and evidence of export exists. Intra-GCC B2B supplies may be zero-rated if the recipient has a VAT number and goods are transported to another GCC state.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration from the Royal Oman Police Customs
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing export
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank statement showing receipt of foreign currency from abroad
Proof of payment of consideration and foreign currency settlement
Copy of customer's non-resident proof and VAT registration certificate, if applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Oman Tax Authority may conduct audit and demand VAT refunds claimed in respect of zero-rated supplies. Penalties for false or fraudulent zero-rating claims include fines, imprisonment for tax fraud, retrospective cancellation of zero-rating, and recovery of VAT plus late payment penalties up to 25% of the unpaid tax. The Taxpayer Name and Shame procedure may apply for serious non-compliance. Customs penalties for improper export documentation include monetary fines and potential confiscation of goods.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO), acting with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion for foreign investment authorization
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Oman operates a broadly liberal current-account and capital-account convertibility regime. The Omani Rial (OMR) is pegged to the USD at 1 OMR = 2.6008 USD. Profit remittance and foreign-currency transfers for permitted current business purposes, including digital game publishing revenues, are freely allowed once corporate tax filings and economic substance obligations are current. Capital inflows by way of foreign equity contribution are permissible under the SPC ownership framework, although shareholder loans and direct foreign borrowings may require CBO notification or prior authorization depending on tenor and external indebtedness. No material dividend repatriation restriction exists for a compliant SPC.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Oman does not impose a statutory export-proceeds surrender rule or mandatory conversion ratio. Export receipts in foreign currency, including proceeds derived from Apple App Store and Google Play payouts for MMORPG subscriptions and in-app purchases, may be retained in foreign-denominated settlement accounts held at licensed Omani banks or remitted to the CBO-licensed authorised dealer. For corporate tax and financial reporting purposes, receipts must be converted into OMR or recorded using transparent exchange rates consistent with CBO-disclosed rates; however, no fixed regulatory timeline compels physical conversion.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account with Foreign Currency Sub-Accounts
Operational Account and Cross-Border Settlement Account
Operational Account and Trade Finance Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Offshore digital EMI providers and non-resident fintech wallet issuers cannot lawfully maintain primary OMR transaction accounts or serve as the core treasury rail for an Omani SPC. Only banks and financial institutions licensed by the CBO may operate payment accounts in Oman. Overseas EMI platforms such as Wise, Revolut Business, or Payoneer may support supplementary receipt of foreign platform revenues, but the corporate treasury backbone must remain a CBO-regulated commercial bank account to satisfy tax, audit, and regulatory traceability requirements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of the SPC director, general manager, or a duly authorised signatory is in practice required for first-time corporate account opening at an Omani bank. The director or natural-person authority holder must appear in person at the branch with an original valid passport, commercial registration certificate, foreign investment approval, and attested constitutional documents. Remote opening is generally unavailable for a foreign-owned SPC without an existing relationship and will be subject to enhanced due diligence. A local registered agent cannot substitute for the mandatory in-person interview unless the bank expressly grants a limited remote exception for a non-resident signatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shareholder structure without demonstrable commercial substance in Oman
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Foreign investment licence; Oman SPC commercial registration certificate; board resolution appointing the SPC manager; local lease agreement or service office contract; employment records or service agreements evidencing substance; business plan and audited or management-prepared financial projections for the MMORPG publishing operation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ambiguity surrounding source of funds for inbound equity injection
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six months of shareholder bank statements; share subscription agreement; confirmation of inward remittance via SWIFT MT103; corporate tax returns of the immediate parent; audited financial statements of the ultimate beneficial owner if applicable; declaration of source of wealth; clarity on the ultimate funding chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident authorized signatory or manager without clear authority chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised and apostilled board resolution; power of attorney for signatories; passport copies with certified translation if applicable; Oman entry stamp or visa documentation; CRS/FATCA self-certification completed on CBO-compliant forms; detailed organisational structure chart.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unfamiliar revenue model of digital platform payouts and in-app purchases
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed Apple App Store and Google Play payout agreements; platform payout statements; App Store Connect and Google Play Console read-only access for compliance review; contractual documentation for foreign sub-licensing or intra-group intellectual property arrangements; bank account statements showing end-to-end payout trails.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Politically exposed person or sanctioned jurisdiction nexus
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full PEP questionnaire; source-of-funds corroboration; independent public-source profile assessment; negative adverse-media screening result; rationale for the Omani SPC structure; formal undertaking to maintain transaction monitoring and immediate disclosure obligations.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Initial equity or shareholder contribution must be routed by BIC-coded SWIFT MT103 transfer from the parent's bank to the Omani SPC's bank account. The remittance shall be clearly labelled in Field 70 with 'SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION / OMAN SPC / CR NUMBER [CR-XXXX] / FOREIGN INVESTMENT FILE NO.' The receiving Omani authorised dealer will categorise the funds as a direct foreign equity inflow supported by the foreign investment approval, incorporation certificate, and SPC constitutional documents. If the inbound remittance is structured as a shareholder loan, a signed facility agreement and repayment schedule are required, and CBO prior approval thresholds may apply. The sender bank must perform source-of-funds compliance; the receiving bank will verify purpose, account name, and UBO classification before crediting.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operating expenditures, platform commissions, intellectual property royalties, software infrastructure fees, and international vendor payments should be settled through SWIFT MT103 outbound transfers from the Omani treasury account. For higher-value third-party licensing or physical equipment procurement, documentary commercial letters of credit opened through a CBO-licensed authorised dealer provide the preferred clearing rail because they preserve title documents, insurance, and settlement integrity. In-country OMR-denominated payments, including payroll, tax duties, social insurance premiums, and administrative costs, should be cleared through the CBO-operated electronic clearing system and Oman Real Time Gross Settlement System (ORTGS). All outbound transfers must be matched against CBO AML/CFT screening, onward transaction filtering, and corporate tax payment certifications.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanilla OMR/USD forward contracts with CBO-licensed authorised dealers
FX swaps on OMR against USD for precise liquidity timing
Cross-currency swaps for OMR against EUR or GBP for regional contractual exposure
Costless collars and OMR/USD nondeliverable structures permitted under the bank's approved derivatives framework

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCI), Commercial Register Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renewal due before expiry of the current registration, typically within the 30-day window immediately preceding the registration anniversary; MOCI discretionary grace period not to exceed 60 days after expiry.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal attracts a progressive administrative penalty under the Commercial Register Law; the commercial registration and SPC legal capacity are suspended, barring contract execution and trading. Continued non-renewal leads to administrative strike-off by MOCI and consequential dissolution proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Audited Financial Statements and Audit Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Sole Shareholder (via annual meeting) and MOCI
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Audited financial statements must be prepared and tabled at the annual shareholder meeting held within four months after the end of the financial year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to prepare audited accounts and table the audit report at the annual meeting is an offence under the Commercial Companies Law. MOCI may impose monetary penalties against the SPC and, for persistent default, cancel the commercial registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Appointment of External Auditor and Filing of Shareholder Resolution
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MOCI (resolution filed with the register of shareholder resolutions)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Auditor appointment resolution must be passed at the annual shareholder meeting within four months of financial year-end; resolution and meeting minutes filed with MOCI within 30 days after the meeting.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Operating without a duly appointed auditor is a statutory violation under the Commercial Companies Law. MOCI may fine the SPC and its management; audited accounts cannot be lawfully approved without an appointed auditor.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Tax Authority, Income Tax Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months after the end of the tax year; for calendar-year SPCs, the annual filing and payment deadline is 31 March following the tax year end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing accrues a civil penalty and interest under the Income Tax Law. The Oman Tax Authority may withhold a tax clearance certificate, blocking commercial registration renewal, government contracting and immigration processing; prolonged non-compliance triggers enforced collection and administrative deregistration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: VAT Return and Annual VAT Reconciliation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly or quarterly return depending on the VAT registration category, due on the 28th day following the end of the tax period; annual VAT reconciliation return due within 28 days after the calendar year end. Applicable only if the SPC exceeds the mandatory VAT registration threshold of OMR 385,000 taxable supplies.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing or late payment triggers fixed and daily penalties under the VAT Law, with a minimum penalty per default of OMR 500. Repeated defaults may lead to tax registration suspension and restriction of import and export authorizations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Re-confirmation and Register Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Any shareholding or beneficial ownership change must be reported within 15 days of the event; beneficial ownership details are also re-confirmed as part of the annual commercial register renewal.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain or notify UBO records is an anti-money laundering law breach punishable by fines against the SPC and its management. MOCI may refuse the annual renewal or strike off the registration for extended non-compliance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No size, revenue or asset threshold exempts an Oman Single Person Company from audit. Every SPC must appoint a licensed auditor and present audited annual financial statements under the Commercial Companies Law, regardless of transaction volume.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and IFRS for SMEs, as authorized for Omani private entities; Omani Accounting Standards are aligned with IFRS. Regulated financial entities must additionally follow Central Bank of Oman or Capital Market Authority filing rules.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SPC must maintain a current beneficial ownership register. Any share transfer or change in ultimate beneficial ownership must be reported to MOCI within 15 days. The annual commercial register renewal includes a statutory declaration confirming the UBO details reflected in the commercial register; all UBO identification documents must be retained for AML compliance for at least five years.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $400 - $1,200 (annual registered office / MOCI compliance agent support fee)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $1,800 - $4,000 (annual fee for a MOCI-licensed auditor for an active SPC with moderate transaction volume)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15% of taxable income under Oman Income Tax Law (Royal Decree 9/2017), applicable to all non-state commercial entities, including a foreign-owned Single Person Company (SPC).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday is available to MMORPG publishing or other digital platform businesses. The effective rate is reduced by directly attributable deductions: development costs, subcontractor fees, store commissions (Apple App Store and Google Play payout fees), IP amortization, and operating expenditures. Targeted incentives exist only for ventures explicitly licensed under the Oman Investment Authority economic programs; such incentives are discretionary and must be in writing before any reduced rate is claimed.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Oman Corporate Income Tax Return Form (Tax Return Form 1), filed exclusively via the Oman Tax Authority electronic services portal (EMTaxs e-filing system).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing is mandatory within 6 months after the end of the fiscal year; for a 31 December year-end, the statutory deadline is 30 June. The Oman Tax Authority may grant a one-time extension of up to 3 months upon a request filed before the original due date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification: legal name, Oman Tax Identification Number (TIN), CR registration number, tax residency status, legal form (SPC/LLC).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Omani SPC's TIN and Commercial Registration number. The foreign parent has no Omani TIN unless it has a permanent establishment in Oman; if the parent is a party to related-party transactions, its home jurisdiction TIN must be listed in the transfer pricing disclosure field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue/turnover: all receipts generated from MMORPG publishing and in-app purchases, stated gross before Apple App Store and Google Play commissions are deducted.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report worldwide revenue from the Omani SPC's contractually guaranteed business activities. Do not net the app store commissions at this line; show gross receipts and deduct commissions as an expense in the cost schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible expenses: directly attributable operating, development, marketing, hosting, tax, legal, licensing and distribution costs; separately identify related-party payments to foreign affiliates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Support every deduction with a valid commercial invoice and bank transfer record. Transactions with the foreign parent or its affiliates must be priced at arm's length and be capable of supporting the arm's length position; otherwise the Tax Authority will disallow the deduction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income / adjusted accounting profit: after formal profit and loss account, Omani tax accounting adjustments, transfer pricing adjustments, prior-year loss set-off, and depreciation/amortization rules.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute the Omani taxable profit without assuming foreign parent losses are available. Loss carryovers from the SPC may be applied for maximum 5 years from the year incurred, subject to continuity of ownership and business activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payable computation: taxable income multiplied by 15%, minus available foreign tax credits, offsetting any advance payments, and resulting final tax payable or refund claimed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholder credits do not reduce the SPC-level Omani tax. Foreign tax credits are claimable only if the income is also subjected to foreign tax and a valid tax residency certificate provides the double-tax treaty basis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Transfer pricing disclosure and related-party transaction schedule: aggregate values of sales, purchases, royalties, interest, cost-sharing and loans with related parties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the aggregate related-party transactions exceed OMR 10 million, this schedule must provide a declaration that the taxpayer has prepared a Master File and Local File in accordance with the Oman Transfer Pricing Guidelines; the same schedule accompanies the annual CIT return and must be certified by the tax representative.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing exposes the SPC to a fixed administrative fine range of OMR 100–OMR 1,000, a 1% per-month (or part thereof) late-payment surcharge up to 50% of the unpaid tax, potential automatic assessment from available taxpayer data, suspension of trade license document application, and enforced collection including attachment of bank accounts. Willful non-filing is referred for criminal prosecution.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% – Oman does not impose withholding tax on dividends distributed by an Omani SPC to its shareholder, whether resident or non-resident, provided the distribution is not a disguised return of capital and the company has met all CIT filing and payment obligations.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim a reduced rate or exemption under any Omani double tax agreement, the non-resident shareholder or payee must submit a formal relief application to the Oman Tax Authority before the payment date where possible. The application must include: (a) the underlying commercial invoice or distribution resolution; (b) a current Tax Residency Certificate issued by the home jurisdiction authority, legalized/apostilled as required; (c) a detailed explanation of the relevant treaty article; and (d) a declaration of no permanent establishment in Oman. The Tax Authority reviews the application and issues a specific approval or letter; no tax relief can be withheld by the payor until the official clearance is on file.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties and non-resident service/technical fees (including software licensing and MMORPG copyright usage) are subject to 10% WHT under domestic Oman law; treaty rates typically reduce royalty withholding to 5%–10% depending on the agreement and residency. Interest paid to unrelated non-resident lenders is generally outside the Omani WHT net unless the lender has a permanent establishment in Oman; interest paid to a related non-resident financing affiliate must be benchmarked for transfer pricing and may attract recharacterization where excessive.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: OMR 10,000,000 (Omani Rials) aggregate related-party transactions; when exceeded, the taxpayer must prepare a Local File and, for multinational groups, a Master File, and the TP disclosure schedule must be filed with the annual CIT return. Transactions below this threshold must still be arm's length and evidence must be contemporaneously retained.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Oman applies a substance-over-form doctrine in income tax administration. The Oman Tax Authority may disregard an SPC or treat a foreign parent as having an Omani taxable permanent establishment where core strategic decisions, employees, servers, or digital operations are in Oman while the taxpayer purports to have no local substance. No standalone Economic Substance Regulation filing is currently mandated for a pure MMORPG publisher, but the SPC must demonstrate real operational authority in Oman: board meetings in Oman, Omani bank account control, local order-to-cash management, and local bookkeeping. Digital platform activities that are managed and controlled from Oman will be assessed as taxable in Oman regardless of billing routing through Apple or Google.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate omission of MMORPG in-app purchase revenue, false invoicing of store commissions, destruction of digital sales records, or submission of a false income tax return with knowledge of understated income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Payment of the full evaded tax plus up to 50% penalty on the evaded amount, increased to 100% in fraud cases; criminal fine of up to OMR 2,000 and imprisonment for up to 5 years; publication of the conviction and debarment from future Oman Investment Authority approvals.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and tax representatives who signed the false return are personally jointly liable for the tax penalty and restitution if the SPC is insolvent; criminal conviction may carry a travel ban, asset freeze, and imprisonment of the responsible director.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance / Abusive Treaty Claim
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a foreign-owned SPC solely to convert in-app purchase profits into dividend distributions and claim treaty exemption while all directors, management, digital assets, servers, and decision-making remain outside Oman.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reclassification of the substance abroad as a foreign permanent establishment in Oman or disallowance of the claimed treaty benefit; assessment of full 15% tax on revenue attributable to Oman plus late-payment surcharges; denial of dividend WHT relief; fines for failure to exhibit substance or maintain accounting records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of the Omani SPC are exposed to personal responsibility for tax debts if the entity is found to be a sham; a foreign parent is also open to Omani court enforcement, which can include prohibitions against purchasing new Omani assets and travel restrictions during investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying inflated license fees, management service fees, Apple-imitation or inter-company financing charges to a related party outside Oman so that the Omani SPC reports artificially low taxable income or reinvestable profits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Adjustment of profits on an arm's length basis and additional tax at 15%; penalty of 10%–20% of the additional tax assessed; late-payment surcharge at 1% per month; in gross misstatement, referral for criminal fraud proceedings and a fine of up to OMR 1,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director who knowingly executed the non-arm's length arrangement is jointly liable with the company for the ultimate tax shortfall; the Tax Authority may pursue personal assets and impose a travel ban pending settlement.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML and Sanctions Compliance with Global App Store Payouts
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing Apple App Store and Google Play payouts routed through UAE clearing banks or foreign distribution account without proper beneficial ownership records, end-user sanctions screening, or unexplained revenue reconciliation, creating an indirect money-laundering or sanctions-transmission risk.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Oman AML law, fines from OMR 1,000 to OMR 200,000 per occurrence or up to twice the value of the illicit transaction; asset confiscation and cancellation of commercial registration; referral to the Public Prosecution for imprisonment; freezing of the Omani SPC accounts by the Central Bank of Oman.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners are personally liable for AML penalties where they knowingly or negligently permitted the SPC to accept proceeds in violation of the AML Law; personal travel bans, five-year disqualification from opening new corporate bank accounts, and criminal imprisonment of up to 7 years apply in aggravated cases.
